prompt: A deterministic unit test fails because one boundary comparison is reversed in a single function. Reproduce and fix it.
context: The failing test, expected behavior, and owning function are supplied. The task touches one implementation file and one existing test file.
expected_orchestration: Keep one write owner. Diagnose briefly in the main session or with one read-only diagnostician only if needed; do not create multiple implementation agents.
acceptance_checks: The existing failure is reproduced before editing.
Only the localized implementation and necessary regression assertion change.
The handoff reports exact commands and preserves unrelated behavior.
failure_signals: Parallel writers touch the same function.
The workflow performs a broad refactor.
The fix is claimed without reproduction or test evidence.
